title: Customer and institution product eligibility policy
workflow: Resolve licensed institution and approved product edition
Retrieve versioned customer/KYC and account eligibility evidence
Evaluate approved residency, risk and legal conditions
Defer ambiguous or missing evidence to human review
Return minimal reasoned decision without leaking restricted screening
Store decision provenance and permit controlled reevaluation
invariants: Eligibility is not a substitute for customer identity verification
Missing mandatory evidence cannot default to eligible
Product permission must be scoped to licensed institution
Never hardcode universal legal-age or residency rules
Customer-facing explanations must not reveal confidential AML suspicion
Eligibility decisions are versioned and reproducible
Denied eligibility cannot be bypassed by another channel
planned_tests: Sensitive AML reason hidden from external applicant
approval_gate: Approved product/institution KYC rules, legal age and residency policy, compliance review.
